title: Clarify no-active archive status diagnostics
outOfScope: Ignoring arbitrary uncommitted start receipts or unrelated worktree changes
Weakening active Contract and Summary pair validation
Changing archive digest, sequence, or manifest integrity rules

sources.reason: live_no_active_changed_files excludes archive paths but currently counts the matching start receipt, making an archive bundle internally inconsistent before its first commit.
No-active status intentionally records zero transient changes, so the consistency checker must recognize the same governed archive boundary.
Existing tests prove arbitrary live changes remain fail closed and provide the regression location for pre-commit archive bundles.
The completed predecessor provides a real contract/summary/manifest/start-receipt bundle that reproduced RFE-ISSUE-116.
The comprehensive plan is the required durable process-problem record.

riskAssessment.reason: Over-broad filtering could hide an orphan start receipt or unrelated change; the exception must be bound to a same-task changed Contract, Summary, and valid archive manifest.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized recording and fixing discovered process defects before resuming planned work and instructed continuous execution.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm only a same-task changed archive Contract, Summary, and valid manifest can exempt a start receipt.
Confirm an orphan or historical start receipt still causes no-active consistency failure.
Confirm post-commit no-active consistency remains unchanged.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Before the first archive-bundle commit, no-active status consistency ignores only the start receipt whose same-task Contract, Summary, and valid archive manifest are all present in the current Git change set.

An orphan start receipt, a receipt paired only with historical archive files, an incomplete changed archive pair, or any unrelated changed path remains visible and causes the no-active consistency check to fail closed.
After the archive bundle is committed, no-active status consistency continues to pass with zero live changes.
Archive integrity is not inferred from filenames alone: the manifest must use the supported format, name the same Work Item, and bind the expected Contract and Summary paths.
The repair command no longer loops on a valid pre-commit archive bundle, while stale or unrelated state still returns an actionable failure.
English and Japanese runtime guidance describe the archive-before-commit boundary and do not imply that arbitrary dirty worktrees are accepted.
RFE-ISSUE-116 is recorded in the comprehensive plan and bidirectionally mapped to implementation, regression tests, and lifecycle verification.
The corrective completes preflight/checkpoints, TDD, full quality, archive, PR, hosted CI, merge, ai-close, and branch cleanup before deep-performance work resumes.
guidelines: No-active status may omit only transient evidence that is structurally owned by the archive transaction.
Filename coincidence alone is not sufficient evidence of archive ownership.
Unrelated worktree changes remain fail closed and visible to the diagnostic.
Error recovery must be executable; do not recommend repair when repair cannot change the blocking condition.

intent.problem: Immediately after ai-finish archives a valid Work Item but before the archive bundle is committed, current_status.md intentionally records zero transient changes while live_no_active_changed_files counts the matching start receipt. check-ai-status-consistency then fails and recommends repair-ai-status, but repair regenerates the same status and fails again.
constraints: Exclude only a start receipt owned by a same-task archive transaction visible in the current Git change set.
Validate the archive manifest identity and expected Contract/Summary paths before treating the receipt as transaction-owned.
Keep orphan receipts, historical-only pairs, incomplete pairs, and unrelated changes fail closed.
Do not edit predecessor archive evidence or resume performance/release changes in this corrective.
intent.rationale: Status generation already excludes transient archive paths; applying the same narrow transaction boundary to the matching start receipt makes pre-commit and post-commit lifecycle states consistent without hiding unrelated dirt.

rawUserRequest: 每个工单遇到流程问题必须记录并先修流程；RFE-ISSUE-116 显示归档后提交前的 no-active consistency 误把同一 archive transaction 的 start receipt 当作状态漂移，并给出无法奏效的 repair 建议。先完成独立 corrective 的完整生命周期，再恢复性能工单。

declaredIntent.summary: Make no-active status consistency understand the narrowly bound pre-commit archive transaction while preserving fail-closed diagnostics for every unrelated change.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A valid same-task pre-commit archive bundle does not make no-active status inconsistent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The matching start receipt is classified as archive-transaction evidence and the consistency check passes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a regression with changed Contract, Summary, valid manifest, index, and start receipt, then assert live changes are empty and validation passes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Incomplete, historical-only, or malformed archive evidence cannot hide a start receipt.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The receipt remains in live changes and no-active consistency fails with an actionable diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add parameterized negative regressions for missing changed pair members, unchanged historical files, manifest identity/path mismatch, and an orphan receipt.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Unrelated dirty paths and normal post-commit no-active state retain existing behavior.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Unrelated paths fail closed; a clean post-commit repository passes with zero live changes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Preserve the existing arbitrary-change regression and add an explicit clean post-commit case alongside focused status tests.
